:::{#def-local-minimizer}
#### Local minimizer

Let $A \subseteq \reals^p$
and let $f : A \to \reals$ be a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function).
A point $x^* \in A$ is a **local minimizer** of $f$
if there is a number $\tolin > 0$
such that $f(x^*) \le f(x)$
for all $x \in A$ with
$\norm{x - x^*} < \tolin$,
where $\norm{\cdot}$ is the
[Euclidean norm](linear-algebra.qmd#def-euclidean-norm).

:::
